title: stardust deploy/media-ledger.json
description: The media upload ledger written by deploy/scripts/da-media-upload.mjs under a cross-process lock (re-read, merge, tmp + rename): one entry per DA media path. The sibling encoder resolves an image's absolute source URL to the entry's contentUrl: every URL in `sources`, and a non-null `source`, maps to it. A ledger written before `sources` existed stays valid; a re-run adds them without uploading.

file.description: the local file uploaded (as given on the command line or in the manifest)

source.description: the manifest's source URL (fetched when the local file was absent); null for --dir uploads

sources.description: every absolute source URL known for the file, sorted, WHATWG-normalised, fragment dropped: the manifest's source/currentSrc and the captured URLs whose localPath in stardust/current/pages/*.json names the file
